RemoteJobAnalysisSource.kt:72 keeps the reason only when status is unchanged and evidence == server.evidenceIds. evidence is server.evidenceIds.filter{}, an order-preserving subsequence of the same list, so the equality is true exactly when nothing was dropped: order cannot cause a false drop, and no dropped id can keep a reason. The first-analysis path matchesOf (line 92) has no evidence check, but its filter set equals the server's: the client sends sendableFacts and CandidateProfile.evidenceIds (CandidateProfile.kt:58) mirrors facts.ts evidenceIds (entry ids, bullet ids, skill:<name>), and analyses.ts:359 already filters to known ids, so nothing is dropped there. upgradedMatch (UpgradedMatch.kt:15) builds a match with no reason. Tests: cachedRematchDropsTheReasonWhenSomeCitedEvidenceIsNoLongerConfirmed (fails at eea4b00c: the reason was kept) and ...AllCitedEvidence... (a pin; it passes at both heads).

AnswerDto.detail (Tailoring.kt:15) has no default and no EncodeDefault, and tailormyresumeJson() keeps explicitNulls on, so a blank detail encodes as "detail":null. This matches answer-facts.ts answerSchema strictObject {requirementId, choice enum of 4, detail string max 400 nullable}. The server answerBlank(null) is true, so a null detail has the same meaning as blank. The only constructor is Mappers.kt:60. Tests that fail at eea4b00c (the key was omitted): RemoteResumeTailorAnswerTest.blankDetailIsSentAsNullDetail, AnalysisRequestJsonTest.blankDetailIsSentAsNullNotOmitted and everyAnswerChoiceCarriesTheThreeKeysTheServerRequires (blank-detail iteration).

The guard path is unchanged. EditType.UNKNOWN is filtered out in toTailoredBullet (Mappers.kt:98) before the domain sees it. TailorResumeUseCase.verified (lines 65-80) checks sourceIds and text only and never reads editTypes, so an UNKNOWN edit cannot get past the I.1 guard. No exhaustive `when` over EditType exists anywhere (searched app, core and feature). The only readers are TailorUiState.kt:144 and BulletReconciler.kt:33, which test REORDER membership, and AccountDataArchiveWriter.kt:276, which writes names. Room JSON stores List<EditType> by name, and UNKNOWN never reaches it. unknownEditTypeDecodesAndIsDropped fails at eea4b00c: decoding throws.

TailoringStatus.UNKNOWN: awaitFinished exits the RUNNING loop (RemoteResumeTailor.kt:79) without polling, pending.clear runs (line 51), and the status is not SUCCEEDED, so the call throws Unavailable. Server semantics at fd43aebb: tailoring statuses are limited to RUNNING/SUCCEEDED/FAILED by the DB CHECK tailormyresume_tailorings_status_check (schema.ts:36,157) and by TailoringView. A credit is spent only in finish() on SUCCEEDED (tailoring.ts finish -> spendTailoringCredit). A finished row stays retrievable by a re-POST with the same requestId (the start/begin existing-row path returns asView with status 200) or by GET /tailorings/:id. Each new requestId reserves a credit and spends it on success (wallet.ts:159). Risk: clearing the id loses a paid result only if a future server returns a new non-terminal status that later becomes SUCCEEDED; the user's retry then starts a new job and is charged a second time. The current contract and DB constraint make this unreachable, so I rate it low and do not report it. Keeping the id would trade it for the round-1 stuck state on a new terminal status. Tests that fail at eea4b00c (decode failure kept tailoring.request.app-1): unknownStatusIsTerminalNotPolledAndClearsRequestId and unknownStatusAfterPollingIsTerminalToo.
